unexpected schemas fail closed instead of presenting candidate data
embedded workspace: collapse keeps retained content mounted, close releases it
mode starters expose real prompts for the two dedicated starts
reopened lead-workers graphs keep the durable preset roles and node state visible
explicit orchestration helper preserves ordered roles and frozen routes
Settings choice survives storage, snapshots and live cross-window events

frontier: Covered helper receipts enforce only the production actions declared by these contracts. UI geometry, browser authority, service-worker lifecycle, backend dispatch and mutation are retained case by case until their own real action contracts and receipts exist.
pitfalls: Proof errors and receipts never record permission storage values or communication credentials.

caseFrontier.case: loader calls catalog and toolchain commands and keeps partial evidence
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: loadMarketplaceView needs a real bridge journey that requests catalog and toolchain independently and retains catalog evidence when the toolchain request fails; normalization is guarded but the async bridge dispatch is not yet enforced.

caseFrontier.case: lifecycle actions call reviewed mutate commands
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: runMarketplaceLifecycleAction disable/rollback needs a real reviewed mutation receipt and target-version binding; the original callback double cannot prove signed activation pointer state.

caseFrontier.case: runtime modes are distinct lifecycles: suspend keeps the session, close ends it
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual runtime readiness, reserved delegation refusal, same-invocation suspend/resume and terminal release require real backend/store receipts; no runtime may be launched outside the user authority boundary.

caseFrontier.case: Builder hands off to Agent Live over shared mission records
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual MissionStore ingest and active handoff needs a real selected-mission bridge journey; shared projection helpers are guarded but polling/handoff state is not yet enforced.

caseFrontier.case: derived mode is truthful: no durable lifecycle is claimed until the backend answers
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: probeAttentionLifecycle needs every real response/error to enforce schema-driven availability before durable controls activate; guarded inbox derivation does not prove the async probe dispatch.

caseFrontier.case: first PWA claim preserves the page and a later replacement reloads once
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: an owned production browser must establish first service-worker claim without reloading the page and one subsequent replacement reload, with enforced controller-change transition.

caseFrontier.case: an already controlled page reloads once for an update
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: an already controlled owned browser needs an actual replacement and one-reload receipt with enforced controller-change transition.

caseFrontier.case: a first claim during registration does not make the next update disappear
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: first claim during service-worker registration needs the next actual replacement to reload once; the existing VM browser double is insufficient for a real lifecycle claim.

caseFrontier.case: settings consume the native receipt and failed archive leaves the chat visible
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: settings must consume the real native cleanup-policy receipt; a rejected archive needs an actual backend error and proof that the chat stays visible without optimistic archival.

caseFrontier.case: Customize team drawer has a real close icon import and render path
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: rendered Customize team drawer must show and operate the close icon in the actual drawer path.

caseFrontier.case: new orchestration conversations persist an immutable exact route snapshot
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: real conversation creation must persist immutable exact route snapshots and customized ordered team roles; resolution alone does not prove creation.

caseFrontier.case: generated HTML preview is opaque-origin sandboxed
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: rendered generated HTML preview needs actual opaque-origin iframe sandbox inspection and script/form behavior without same-origin authority.

caseFrontier.case: managed CLI actions return the real adapter response
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: managed-CLI action handler must return the actual adapter response and imported selection receipt through the rendered Builder action.

caseFrontier.case: Agent Live preview opening is target-aware and scope-gated
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: preview opening needs actual observed target scope checks and focus on the matching message in Agent Live.

caseFrontier.case: mission controls distinguish whole-mission stop from lane inspection
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: rendered mission stop must issue whole-mission pause and display its receipt independently of lane inspection.

caseFrontier.case: exact runtime invocations carry an explicit route policy
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: exact runtime invocation needs a real explicit-route backend execution receipt; source literals do not prove absence of silent fallback.

caseFrontier.case: Run approved orchestration uses the real bounded execution command
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: Run approved orchestration needs rendered input/context and a real bounded execution receipt from the approved plan.

caseFrontier.case: Lead plus workers is a reusable bounded preset, not a synthetic candidate scorer
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: guarded lead/worker preset roles and routes are covered, but this mixed case also requires actual dynamic plan request/approval/spawn integration with no synthetic scoring path.

caseFrontier.case: Customize team exposes Codex and filters snapshots to customized roles
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual Customize team UI must offer Codex and filter the persisted route snapshot to customized roles; catalog facts alone cannot prove the UI.

caseFrontier.case: Builder keeps the graph first and the conversation rail compact
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual Builder desktop and mobile graph/rail layout, disclosure order, child routes and pre-mount loading canvas require rendered geometry and interaction receipts.

caseFrontier.case: Builder operator polish stays local-first and keeps one empty-state launch path
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual empty Builder must expose one launch path, disable blank input, require review before spawn and preserve local font loading plus current-plan marker.

caseFrontier.case: Neyvia structural materials stay neutral instead of becoming an accent wash
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: neutral structural materials require computed token colors and distinct surface values in an actual rendered shell; source regex cannot prove cascade.

caseFrontier.case: identity and semantic colors remain distinct from structural material
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: accent, success and information colors require actual computed saturation and separation from structural materials.

caseFrontier.case: shared visual language preserves surface-specific material roles
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: every surface material role, primary action and reduced-motion treatment needs rendered computed styles under its matching surface.

caseFrontier.case: legacy workspace and conversation shell cannot fall back to green-black
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual classic workspace background/sidebar needs computed neutral material and border geometry after all stylesheet overrides.

caseFrontier.case: the pre-mount loading state uses the product material without an outline card
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: pre-mount loading canvas needs actual scheme-specific appearance and reduced-motion behavior before React removes it.

caseFrontier.case: disabled Phone actions cannot become the brightest primary object
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual disabled Phone action needs computed background/opacity and brightness relative to enabled primary actions.

caseFrontier.case: Agent Preview has a composed empty state and a true expanded canvas
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: Agent Preview empty and expanded states need rendered composition, resize/expand interactions and full viewport bounds with hidden competing surfaces.

caseFrontier.case: Agent Live exposes one working scroller and a compact conversation index
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: Agent Live scrolling and compact index need actual overflow ownership, four-item cutoff and Show more interaction without nested scrollers.

caseFrontier.case: the local verifier target renders despite unrelated conversation mission scope
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual local verifier preview must render despite unrelated conversation mission scope.

caseFrontier.case: the real embedded click-probe app shares the titanium visual system
caseFrontier.reason: Retained: actual served click-probe page needs computed shared material colors and a real embedded click receipt.
